text:
Carla R.: Drafting a Terraform module for NimbleCloud marketplace onboarding. Sharing quick notes and a repo link: https://git.internal.redwood/nimblecloud/marketplace-iaac. Need: cross-account IAM role pattern, minimal outputs, and a passing CI artifact that marketplace will accept.
Dmitri L.: 👍 can you paste the provider snippets you're using? marketplace wants explicit region/provider blocks to avoid implicit defaults.
Carla R.: Sure — using a pinned provider and assume_role for deploy:
```hcl
provider "nimble" {
  version = "~> 2.4"
  region  = var.region
}
provider "aws" {
  alias  = "partner"
  region = var.aws_region
  assume_role {
    role_arn = var.partner_role_arn
  }
}
```
Alice M.: Quick Q — do we need separate modules for x86 vs arm (Graviton)? NimbleCloud images are mixed in their marketplace regions.
Dmitri L.: Prefer a single module with a variables map and an example overlay for arm vs x86 AMI/instance_type. Add a qa matrix in GH actions.
Ben K.: Marketplace packaging note: we must include a short README template, a validated module registry entry, and license file. Also marketplace scans for network firewall rules — include a minimal example that locks ports.
Carla R.: Good call. I'll add README/SECURITY.md and a small GH Actions matrix: linux x86/arm, terraform 1.4/1.5. infra-bot — can you queue a smoke build?
InfraBot: CI queued: nimble-marketplace/terraform-module main — build #142 started. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/build/142
Alice M.: Thanks — will review the IAM assumptions tomorrow morning. If we can get the CI green, we'll send to NimbleCloud partner team for pre-scan.
Ben K.: leave a note for partner PM about the supported AZs and recommended instance families.
Carla R.: Will do. Tagging @Ben K. for the checklist. :rocket:
